scripts.test: pnpm test:backend && pnpm test:types && pnpm test:core && pnpm test:app
scripts.test:types: pnpm -C packages/backend run typecheck && pnpm -C apps/web run build
scripts.test:app: cd apps/macos && export DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer && xcodegen generate && rm -rf .build/DerivedData/Logs/Test && xcodebuild test -project Whistle.xcodeproj -scheme Whistle -destination 'platform=macOS' -derivedDataPath .build/DerivedData -collect-test-diagnostics never COMPILER_INDEX_STORE_ENABLE=NO
